_comment: Every site-wide setting lives here. Change a value, run build.py, commit docs/.
name: Saaz
_legalName: ASSUMPTION: company registration not verified. Use the registered name once confirmed.
_basePath: GitHub Pages project URL is jamesssemujju.github.io/saaz/. Use "/" if the site moves to its own domain.
_whatsapp: PLACEHOLDER. Digits only with country code, e.g. 2567XXXXXXXX. Empty = every WhatsApp link stays hidden.
_supabaseUrl: From Supabase: Project Settings > API > Project URL, e.g. https://abcd1234.supabase.co. Empty = admin page shows set-up instructions and the site uses src/data/cars.json only.
_supabaseAnonKey: From Supabase: Project Settings > API > anon public key. This key is meant to be public; the database rules in supabase/schema.sql protect the data. Never put the service_role key here.
